notes: Item 19 is present and discloses Gross Consumer Sales only (no cost, profit, or margin data). Data covers the 12-month period ended December 31, 2025. Section A covers 11 US franchises (USD). Section B covers 14 Canadian franchises in aggregate (CDN and USD). Section C breaks Canadian franchises into: (1) open 10 years or less (7 franchises), (2) open more than 10 years (5 franchises), and (3) owned outlets / Brand Leader franchises (2 franchises). CDN-to-USD conversion rate was 1.37. One anomaly noted: for the 'open 10 years or less' cohort, the document states the low converted-to-USD value as $216,024, which does not match $157,682 CDN / 1.37 (~$115,024 USD) — this may be a document error or OCR artifact; the stated value was transcribed as-is. Individual franchise-level records for US franchises are included as separate records for granularity. The 'Owned Outlets' are technically Brand Leader-owned franchises, not company-owned by the franchisor itself; classified as all_company_owned as the closest schema match with a caveat in notes.
